sources.title: aryamanjalali/breast-cancer-detection - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project implements a state-of-the-art medical imaging system for breast cancer detection using deep learning. The system processes mammogram images with CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) augmentation and employs ResNet50 U-Net architecture for accurate segmentation and classification. Key Achievement: 91% Dice score on 780+ mammogram images.

sources.title: AI Breast Cancer Detection System - GitHub
sources.snippet: AI Breast Cancer Detection System An end-to-end AI-powered web application for detecting breast cancer from mammogram images using Deep Learning and Hybrid Machine Learning models.

sources.title: PDF Detection and classification of mammogram using ResNet‐50
sources.snippet: The Curated Breast Imaging Subset of DDSM (CBIS-DDSM) is divided into innocuous and harmful using a variety of models, including the VGG16, VGG19, and ResNet50 mod-els. Additionally, the breast region from the mammography images is fragmented using the provided changed U-Net model.
